On-device text recognition for ingredient photos. Everything here runs inside the
app; no file is downloaded at run time and no photo leaves the phone.

- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 5.1.1 (npm), Apache-2.0
  (LICENSE-tesseract.js.txt; bundled third-party notices in LICENSE-bundled.txt).
- core/tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (npm), Apache-2.0
  (LICENSE-tesseract.js-core.txt). Tesseract OCR itself is Apache-2.0.
- lang/spa.traineddata.gz: @tesseract.js-data/spa 1.0.0 (npm, MIT), folder
  4.0.0_best_int: the Spanish LSTM model from tesseract-ocr/tessdata (Apache-2.0).

Source maps were removed from the two .min.js files (the maps are not shipped).
